programme.desc: Yuan Ge membaiki hubungan mereka dengan membawa Bing Wen bertemu ayahnya secara rasmi. Sementara itu, Gu Qiao terganggu kerana Xiong Qi Ming membantu Qiao memperoleh kontrak dari seorang pelanggan tanpa pengetahuannya.

programme.title: YOUR FINESSE
programme.desc: Fu Ling, Fei Ren, Gong Xin dan Tai Shuai meminta ketua Jiang Gong, Yuan Yujiu, membatalkan perintah memaksa Fu Ling berkahwin dengan Gong Xin dan melaksankan hukuman mati terhadap Fei Ren. Permintaan mereka ditolak.

programme.title: MY TWIN LOVER
programme.desc: Ming and Qin, twin brothers, Gemini, 35 years old. The identical twins are so alike even their own family can’t tell them apart. When they were young, they also pretend to be each other, the older one will swap places with the younger one.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Chang gembira dendamnya terhadap keluarga Luo terbalas, namun diselubungi kesedihan atas kehilangan Jing Yi serta tindakan Ivan menamatkan hubungan. Kehadiran Li Ping dan Qing Tian yang tidak disangka mengejutkan lagi situasi.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Jiang Yi dan Ivan yang meluangkan masa di taman sebelum Ivan menyelamatkan seorang lelaki daripada serangan babi hutan. Penemuan gelang tangan yang serupa mencetuskan misteri, diikuti pertengkaran antara Jiang Yi dan lelaki itu.

programme.title: THE QUEEN OF NEWS 2
programme.desc: Sze-ching berasa tidak puas hati apabila Kingston menguasai siaran bersama lapan saluran. Pada masa sama, SNK mendedahkan rahsia silam Man yang mengejutkan, manakala Suet-kwun mendesak Man agar berani berdepan dengan traumanya.

programme.title: PURSUIT OF JADE
programme.desc: Datuk Chang Yu mendedahkan kepadanya bahawa ayahnya Fan Er Niu bukan anak kandungnya. Fan Er Niu diterima masuk ke dalam keluarga Fan, kerana menghadapi masalah semasa menjalankan tugas mengiringi penghantaran barang.

programme.title: I BELIEVE I CAN FLY
programme.desc: Shun Tian yang mewakili rakan-rakanya untuk berunding dengan kumpulan kongsi gelap, rela melepaskan wang hadiah demi keselamatan. Persahabatan mereka tetap utuh setelah selamat pulang dari Thailand. Yi Long terus dipinggirkan oleh keluarganya.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF HEROES
programme.desc: Huang Rong dan Guo Jing berjaya melepaskan diri dari Gunung Tapak Besi dengan menunggang helang putih. Mereka tiba di sebuah pondok kecil dalam hutan dan menerima bantuan daripada seorang wanita bernama Yinggu.

programme.title: LET'S GO HOME
programme.desc: Episod ini Bryan, pengacara 8 E-News, menemani pengacara veteran 8TV, Xiao Yu melawat beberapa tempat menarik di Kuala Lumpur untuk mengimbau kenangan manis zaman mudanya di ibu kota dan sempat menikmati makanan enak.

programme.title: WOMEN WALK THE LINE
programme.desc: Gu Qiao berkeras untuk mencapai kejayaan melalui usahanya sendiri. Gu Qiao teruja apabila Bing Wen mengumumkan kenaikan pangkat dan kenaikan gajinya. Sementara itu, Yuan Ge menasihati Yan Xi supaya berdamai dengan Gu Qiao.

programme.title: YOUR FINESSE
programme.desc: Fu Ling yang rasa kesal kerana mengecewakan Da Feing dengan mengahwini Fei Ren, kini menenggelamkan diri dalam bermacam-macam kerja, demi meredakan rasa bersalahnya. Sementara itu Changshan Men, sebuah rumah pelacuran.

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special "reunion dinner" on the eve of the Torch Festival - just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.2: New Jewels
programme.desc: In the second episode of our Xiamen series, host Tianran He and co-host Laura, an American who has lived in Xiamen for 7 years, guide you to discover Xiamen's internationalization, modernization, and unique fashion vibe. First, they cycle along the island road, taking in the stunning coastal scenery of the famous Round-the-Island Road, and step into Zengcuoan - once a small fishing village, now a thriving creative hub - to showcase its remarkable transformation. Next, Laura leads Tianran to experience the daily life of expats in Xiamen: exploring the lively coffee bar street, and joining a fun gathering at a stylish French restaurant. A passionate lover of Chinese culture, Laura invites Tianran to experience a traditional Chinese tea ceremony. After that, the pair head to Xiamen's fashion central business district, experimenting with bold new looks in clothing stores that have caught the eye of the global fashion community. Finally, Tianran visits an egret habitat to meet photographers who document these beautiful birds, and together they admire the grace of Xiamen's iconic egrets.

programme.title: An Encounter with China's Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father" - Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group - who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin - Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water - an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China's landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China's ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake's matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali's earth-driven crafts, Guizhou's wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia's new nomadic life - the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: From bean to cup: The rise of China's specialty coffee
programme.desc: Pu'er, a city named after tea, is now at the center of another brewing story: China's fast-rising coffee industry. How are farmers, industry professionals, and consumers shaping a new coffee ecosystem in China? Join us as we explore how China's coffee culture is evolving - from origin to cup.

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special "reunion dinner" on the eve of the Torch Festival - just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker's Guide to China: Changbai Mountain
programme.desc: An unforgettable adventure awaits amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Changbai Mountain! Embark on a trek through pristine birch forests, marvel at the majestic power of the world's deepest volcanic waterfall, and uncover hidden gems along the way. Indulge in soaking in natural hot springs and experience exhilarating rafting down mountain streams, all leading to the final destination: Tianchi Lake, a heavenly oasis nestled in the clouds. Join the Travelogue team as we delve into the beauty of Changbai Mountain.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.2: New Jewels
programme.desc: In the second episode of our Xiamen series, host Tianran He and co-host Laura, an American who has lived in Xiamen for 7 years, guide you to discover Xiamen's internationalization, modernization, and unique fashion vibe. First, they cycle along the island road, taking in the stunning coastal scenery of the famous Round-the-Island Road, and step into Zengcuoan - once a small fishing village, now a thriving creative hub - to showcase its remarkable transformation. Next, Laura leads Tianran to experience the daily life of expats in Xiamen: exploring the lively coffee bar street, and joining a fun gathering at a stylish French restaurant. A passionate lover of Chinese culture, Laura invites Tianran to experience a traditional Chinese tea ceremony. After that, the pair head to Xiamen's fashion central business district, experimenting with bold new looks in clothing stores that have caught the eye of the global fashion community. Finally, Tianran visits an egret habitat to meet photographers who document these beautiful birds, and together they admire the grace of Xiamen's iconic egrets.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.2: New Jewel
programme.desc: In the second episode of our Xiamen series, host Tianran He and co-host Laura, an American who has lived in Xiamen for 7 years, guide you to discover Xiamen's internationalization, modernization, and unique fashion vibe. First, they cycle along the island road, taking in the stunning coastal scenery of the famous Round-the-Island Road, and step into Zengcuoan - once a small fishing village, now a thriving creative hub - to showcase its remarkable transformation. Next, Laura leads Tianran to experience the daily life of expats in Xiamen: exploring the lively coffee bar street, and joining a fun gathering at a stylish French restaurant. A passionate lover of Chinese culture, Laura invites Tianran to experience a traditional Chinese tea ceremony. After that, the pair head to Xiamen's fashion central business district, experimenting with bold new looks in clothing stores that have caught the eye of the global fashion community. Finally, Tianran visits an egret habitat to meet photographers who document these beautiful birds, and together they admire the grace of Xiamen's iconic egrets.

programme.title: An Encounter with China's Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father" - Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group - who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin - Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water - an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China's landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China's ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake's matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali's earth-driven crafts, Guizhou's wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia's new nomadic life - the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Valentine's for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community's brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine's Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.3: Home Away From Home
programme.desc: In the third episode of our Xiamen series, we introduce four expats from BRICS countries and their inspiring lives in Xiamen. Bjorn, from South Africa, is deeply passionate about Chinese food culture and architecture, and is even skilled at oracle bone script calligraphy. Living in Shapowei, Xiamen's busiest creative district, he knows every street and lane intimately, and has a profound love for the city's charm. Atul Verma, a yoga teacher from India, opened a yoga studio in Xiamen and built a new career here. Surrounded by Xiamen's peaceful Buddhist atmosphere, he has found a true sense of home in this foreign land. Juan Guimaraes, from Brazil, is an international freshman studying medicine at Xiamen University. Filled with curiosity and longing for both the campus and the city, he hopes to live a fulfilling life at the university and fall in love with Xiamen. Rustam Apushev, from Russia, is known to everyone as a loving "super dad", but his true identity is a former boxing champion with countless championship medals. He met his wife in Xiamen, raised two children, founded his own school, and started a whole new life. "Xiamen is my home," he says.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music." The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music." The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Valentine's for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community's brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine's Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music." The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for LEEBADA x I’m LIVE by LEEBADA
[TV’s on] The pad and guitar together create a sound that evokes feelings of being in a dark room [ FLOWER] Please enjoy the mellow R&B harmonies creating a dreamy sound [Diving] This is my musical expression of ocean waves rolling into shore. Please close your eyes and savor every bit [Blue rose] This is how I imagine dawn with various shades of blue [Believe what you want] This is my musical portrait that I wrote in 2018, inspired by the sadness of loss and betrayal. The protagonist tells people to believe what they want to believe with restrained emotions.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for An Shin-ae x I’m LIVE by An Shin-ae
[Hold Me Now] This song was written when I was going through possibly the toughest time of my life. When you need something to lean on, this is what I'd like to offer – An Shin-ae [Inefficient Love] Love is awfully inefficient, especially in the city where efficiency is everything. However, where there is life, there is love. Please enjoy how love enriches our lives through the song’s progression. [Dear City] This song features the sounds of Jeju’s Gotjawal Forest. Nature encompasses everything, so let’s immerse in its beauty for a few minutes. [Soul] This is a new arrangement of “Soul,” produced by my friend cloud koh. Our synergy and harmony will present a prime example of soul music [Respect] This is my debut song with a message that everyone should be respected. I hope it reminds you of what you deserve

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is sunwoojunga! [JAZZ BOX] Everything is possible in the name of jazz! Please enjoy the endless rhythmic changes and unique sounds [What the hell] Enough is enough! Stop wasting your time and energy on those who aren’t worth it [STAR CANDY] Let’s swallow up this intense dance song! [Youth, for a while] It’s my diary I wrote during my young and fragile youth [Shimmer] From slow to explosive, please listen for the cathartic flow of energy!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for YdBB x I’m LIVE by YdBB
[ONCE] This is our message to those we cherish most. We will always be together like today and forever [RUNAWAY] Let’s forget all our worries and run away! [ Voyage] Full of refreshing sounds, this is a quintessential summer song [LETTER] It’s our debut song! Please sing along to the outro with usB [Today is the day] Today is the day when your dreams can come true!

Instruction Manual for LEEBADA x I’m LIVE by LEEBADA
[TV’s on] The pad and guitar together create a sound that evokes feelings of being in a dark room [ FLOWER] Please enjoy the mellow R&B harmonies creating a dreamy sound [Diving] This is my musical expression of ocean waves rolling into shore. Please close your eyes and savor every bit [Blue rose] This is how I imagine dawn with various shades of blue [Believe what you want] This is my musical portrait that I wrote in 2018, inspired by the sadness of loss and betrayal. The protagonist tells people to believe what they want to believe with restrained emotions.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for An Shin-ae x I’m LIVE by An Shin-ae
[Hold Me Now] This song was written when I was going through possibly the toughest time of my life. When you need something to lean on, this is what I'd like to offer – An Shin-ae [Inefficient Love] Love is awfully inefficient, especially in the city where efficiency is everything. However, where there is life, there is love. Please enjoy how love enriches our lives through the song’s progression. [Dear City] This song features the sounds of Jeju’s Gotjawal Forest. Nature encompasses everything, so let’s immerse in its beauty for a few minutes. [Soul] This is a new arrangement of “Soul,” produced by my friend cloud koh. Our synergy and harmony will present a prime example of soul music [Respect] This is my debut song with a message that everyone should be respected. I hope it reminds you of what you deserve

programme.title: I'M LIVE - FROM ALL TO HUMAN
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the R&B quintet FROM ALL TO HUMAN! Composed of vocalist Blesssing guitarist PARK JAE WOO bassist NAM WOO SEOK keyboardist MOON SUNG HWAN and drummer MOON SEONG HO this band brought a new wave of R&B to the Korean music scene upon their debut in 2017. With their band's name referring to a journey “from all beings to humans” the five hope to develop every day as musicians. True to their name they are evolving and developing every day winning the Grand Prize at the 2019 Shinhan Card Rookie Project and the TOP2 at KT&G’s SangSang Madang Band Discovery Competition in 2019. From acid jazz to R&B to new jack swing the quintet covers a wide range of genres in their music backed up by solid storylines which makes them truly one of a kind. In this episode FROM ALL TO HUMAN performs Dizzy Oriental chill Don't be disappointed and more to showcase the quintessence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five genuine musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - ADOY
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the city pop band ADOY! Composed of vocalist and guitarist Oh Juhwan keyboardist Zee bassist Jung Dayoung and drummer Park Geunchang this quartet burst onto the music scene in 2017 with the EP CATNIP. Thanks to the success of Grace and San Francisco from the EP they topped the K-Indie Chart and became nominated for Best Modern Rock at the prestigious Korean Music Awards in 2018. Then in the following year they won Judges' Prize at the Seoul Music Awards creating a new flow of Korean city pop. ADOY's music has a special power. Iit fills the city with romantic vibes instantly and also transforms city noises into sophisticated tunes. What's more their music has mass appeal yet it is unique. So now the quartet itself is a genre that mesmerizes not only Korean listeners but also the world. Last month ADOY released their new EP her to display their ever-evolving artistry and the quartet is here to perform their latest tracks including Simply Antihero Baby and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet ADOY!

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SANTAI 5-8
programme.desc: Segmen Santai 5-8 mengandungi zon muzik segmen Lagu 60 an pada Isnin Laguku Kuasa Dua pada Selasa Rabu Lagu dan Kenangan Khamis Secangkir Bicara/Nurul Al-Quran dan Jumaat La Khobar. Sabtu dan Ahad segmen Hello Hello MELAKAfm pilihan lagu dan ucapan pendengar

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. Turut disajikan 'Waronk Dangdut pada Sabtu dan Syok 80-90 pada Ahad.

programme.title: KONA MAI 2026
programme.desc: Rehatkan minda anda pada penghujung hari bersama Shah, Faruk & Mimie dalam segmen KONA MAI. Segmen ini membawakan pilihan lagu santai, pengisian rohani, serta seleksi lagu-lagu kesukaan anda di Tapaw Lagu @ Kafe Muzik. Sebelum melelapkan mata, nikmati alunan lagu-lagu melankolik terkini, bahasa Melayu, Inggeris, dan Indonesia untuk menemani malam anda dengan penuh kedamaian.

programme.title: GENG PAGI MUTIARA
programme.desc: Mulakan Pagi anda dengan penuh bersemangat bersama Chombi dan Bambam!\\n Segmen ini menyajikan gabungan lengkap untuk memulakan hari anda dengan positif—daripada pengisian rohani menerusi bacaan Al-Quran, nasyid, dan Santai Nurani, hinggalah kepada berita sahih, laporan trafik semasa, tajuk-tajuk akhbar utama, serta topik pagi yang santai dan menghiburkan. Jangan lupa layan lagu-lagu permintaan anda dalam slot Layan Pagi sebelum melangkah ke tengah hari!

programme.title: FOKUS MUTIARA
programme.desc: Sambil buat kerja atau berehat, penyampai kami Azie, Elly , Mimie & Fazrinah sedia menemani dengan pelbagai maklumat berguna dan hiburan menarik. Dapatkan petua serta tips gaya hidup serta pelbagai perkongsian harian yang terkini. Nikmati juga kelainan irama Bollywood menerusi Syoknya Hindi & mengimbau memori menerusi Everlasting Memory dengan lagu retro Inggeris terbaik serta laporan berita Warta Mutiara secara langsung bagi memastikan anda sentiasa peka dengan isu semasa.

programme.title: PETANG KREW
programme.desc: Petang anda pastinya tidak hambar bersama gandingan serasi Amin , Que , Mimie dan Fazrinah! Sambil melayan perjalanan pulang dari kerja, dapatkan pengisian Mutiara Ilmu, tips keusahawanan dalam Biz On Air, serta bincangkan pelbagai Isu hangat dan menarik menerusi Ralet Cheq. Tak lengkap petang anda tanpa menguji minda dalam peraduan Teka Tiara Nyanyi bersama kemaskini trafik dan berita terkini.

On a much smaller scale, an abandoned rabbit with an urgent dental problem and Matt discovers that picking up a penguin isn't as easy as it sounds.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: At a house in Hull, Inspector Claire Little rescues two flea infested Staffordshire Bull Terriers named Roxy and Madison that are missing half of their fur. As Claire begins her investigation, will the scratching Staffies be able to recover?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud

programme.title: National Anthem
programme.desc: The broadcast of Malaysia’s national anthem, Negaraku, marks the beginning of the daytime broadcast schedule.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us is a compilation of human-interest stories from around the world. This episode features a Women-run hotel in Sri Lanka that empowers women through the tourism industry. It also highlights Traditional wooden toy-making in Channapatna, India, where local artisans strive to preserve their craft amid modernisation and competition from imported products. Efforts to save the northern white rhino at Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya continue through in vitro fertilisation (IVF) technology to prevent the subspecies from becoming extinct. Meanwhile, Benin’s textile industry is expanding its local manufacturing capabilities, shifting from raw cotton exports to textile production to create jobs and boost the country’s economy. The episode also explores the importance of international engagement and dialogue in helping countries such as Malaysia compete in an increasingly interconnected world.

programme.title: Global Perspective
programme.desc: This episode of Global Perspective discusses the evolution of Malaysia’s foreign policy since Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim took office in November 2022, focusing on strengthening ties with Islamic countries in areas including the Palestinian issue, economic cooperation, education and moderation. The programme also highlights Malaysia’s strategic relations with Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan and Central Asia, as well as the potential for international media collaboration to strengthen diplomacy and deliver accurate information to global audiences.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us explores diverse cultural traditions, artistic expressions and heritage from around the world, including ice carving in Japan, a unique peanut butter art installation in Rotterdam, Arabian horse traditions in Palestine and camel racing in Australia. This episode also highlights the traditional fishing practices of the Imragan community in Mauritania, France’s return of historical Syrian artefacts, and Malaysia’s strategic role in strengthening international relations and amplifying the voices of the Global South.

programme.title: ASEAN - Rasa ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa ASEAN is an 11-episode travelogue featuring fusion cuisine from ASEAN countries while showcasing local cultures and traditions. Hosted by Chef Fikri and Chef Naim, the programme brings together professional and renowned chefs to explore the region’s diverse culinary heritage.\n\nIn this episode, both chefs travel to Cambodia to discover its local cuisine and cultural traditions.

programme.title: ASEAN - Jejak Halal ASEAN
programme.desc: Jejak Halal ASEAN is a travelogue exploring the diverse cultures and lifestyles of Muslim communities across ASEAN countries. In this episode, the programme travels to Songkhla, Thailand, to discover the local Muslim community and its way of life.

programme.title: ASEAN -Women Entrepreneurship
programme.desc: This episode of ASEAN Women Entrepreneurship highlights the determination of women entrepreneurs from Cambodia and Brunei in developing their businesses and contributing to economic growth. programme.title: An Unquiet Grave
programme.desc: A year after Jamie's wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

programme.title: Mama Ghost
programme.desc: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: They Wait in the Dark
programme.desc: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amy's Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

programme.title: Model Family
programme.desc: Single mother Yu Xiang and her daughter Tong Tong move into a neighbourhood where every family appears to live a perfect life. Beneath the idyllic façade lie hidden secrets. As tensions and suspicion grow, buried fears, anxieties and the darkest sides of human nature emerge, trapping the mother and daughter in a psychological nightmare.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Ten Minutes to Midnight
programme.desc: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

programme.title: 3 Demons
programme.desc: Deputy Sheriff James is assigned to guard the body of a woman used in a mysterious ritual. After accidentally completing the unfinished ceremony, he unleashes three dark demons. As psychological torment, terrifying hallucinations and real demonic forces close in, his sanity slowly unravels, plunging him into an inescapable abyss of darkness.

Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

programme.title: Behave
